metadata.description: Agent skills and plugins for SDSC systems. Starts with the National Research Platform (Nautilus); other SDSC systems to follow.

plugins.name: nrp-nautilus
plugins.description: Run work on the National Research Platform's Nautilus Kubernetes cluster without hurting it: access and NRP policies, taking your code to a running Job, GPUs, Ceph storage and S3, the managed LLM endpoint, and a preflight check that stops the patterns that overload a shared cluster.
